thought.text: The registry is reachable and requires auth. Let me test whether images can be pulled anonymously or via a public token endpoint.

reasoning_content:
The registry is reachable, but authentication is required (401). Let me try checking the WWW-Authenticate header and looking for a public token endpoint. GitLab registries typically have a public token endpoint at `/v2/token?service=...&scope=repository:...:pull` that can be used to fetch a token for public projects.

Let me test it:
`curl https://registry.opencode.de/v2/token?service=container-registry&scope=repository:bpa/audiominer/web-service:pull`

I'll also try `docker pull` to see the actual error message.

action.command: timeout 30 curl -sSI https://registry.opencode.de/v2/ 2>&1 | head -10; echo "====="; timeout 30 curl -sS "https://registry.opencode.de/v2/token?service=container-registry&scope=repository:bpa/audiominer/web-service:pull" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; echo "====="; timeout 60 docker pull registry.opencode.de/bpa/audiominer/web-service:latest 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "pull exit: $?"
